name: Can I perform tankless water heater maintenance myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I perform tankless water heater maintenance myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some basic tasks like cleaning external filters can be done by homeowners, comprehensive tankless water heater maintenance, especially descaling, is best left to a professional. Improper flushing can damage the unit or lead to safety hazards. Our technicians have the specialized tools and training to safely and effectively service all major tankless water heater brands.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic filter cleaning can be done by homeowners, but comprehensive maintenance and descaling should be performed by a professional to avoid damage or safety risks.
